question: Why did my energy bills change in April?

result.question: Why did my energy bills change in April?

answers.question: Why did my energy bills change in April?

causes.detail: The unit rate went from 28.31p per kWh to 24.70p per kWh.
The standing charge went from 50.77p to 47.07p a day.
The later bill covered 30 days; the earlier one covered 31.
No estimated reading moved the billed units enough to matter.
Neither bill has a different credit or one-off charge.
Not enough data to decide: the household's pattern changed, so the weather fit doesn't predict the earlier bill.
Beyond the weather, daily use changed by 13%.
Beyond the weather, gas use changed by −91% and electricity by +13%: a switch from gas to electric heating.

answers.answer_markdown: Your electricity bill went down by {F1}, from {F2} in March to {F3} in April [E2][E5]. The unit rate fell from {F7} to {F8}, which took {F4} off the bill, and the daily standing charge dropped from {F9} to {F10}, saving another {F6} [E2][E1][E4]. At the same time, your household used more electricity than the weather would explain, with daily electricity use up {F11} and gas use down {F12}, suggesting a switch from gas to electric heating that added {F5} to the bill [E2][E1][E3][E5]. We checked whether the billing period length, meter estimates, one‑off credits or the weather itself made a difference, and none of those had a measurable effect.

evidence.title: Daily weather
evidence.sql:
SELECT day, tmean_c, tmax_c, rain_mm, hdd
FROM whybill.weather_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2026-05-01'
ORDER BY day

evidence.title: Electricity bills
evidence.sql:
SELECT utility, supplier, bill_id, period_start, period_end, days, units_billed, units_true, unit, read_type,
       energy_gbp, standing_gbp, adjustments_gbp, adjustment_note, total_gbp
FROM whybill.bills
WHERE utility = 'electricity'
ORDER BY utility, period_start

evidence.title: Electricity meter readings
evidence.sql:
SELECT utility, read_date, register, unit, source
FROM whybill.reads
WHERE utility = 'electricity' AND read_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-05-01'
ORDER BY read_date

evidence.title: Electricity tariff
evidence.sql:
SELECT utility, kind, valid_from, valid_to, value, unit
FROM whybill.tariffs
WHERE utility = 'electricity' AND valid_from <= '2026-05-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > '2026-03-02')
ORDER BY kind, valid_from

evidence.title: Gas bills
evidence.sql:
SELECT utility, supplier, bill_id, period_start, period_end, days, units_billed, units_true, unit, read_type,
       energy_gbp, standing_gbp, adjustments_gbp, adjustment_note, total_gbp
FROM whybill.bills
WHERE utility = 'gas'
ORDER BY utility, period_start
